title_zh: 选择从香草插枝开始参加种植课

scenario.label_zh: 选择从香草插枝开始参加种植课
scenario.goal_zh: 表达对繁殖香草的好奇，并选定小组课程中的插枝练习

context_zh: 社区花园课程报名处，初学者询问当日香草繁殖示范。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Jenna
sentences.text: I've always wanted to cultivate herbs, but I only have a windowsill.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: You can start with one small pot. In today's session, would you like to start from seed or take a cutting from the mint plant?

sentences.speaker: Jenna
sentences.text: A piece of the existing plant can grow into a new one? Now you've really sparked my curiosity.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: It can, and I will demonstrate our method in the session. You do not need to bring any equipment.

sentences.speaker: Jenna
sentences.text: I'll join the cutting group, then. I would rather learn with one small plant than start a whole tray of seeds.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: Come to the potting table at two. We will label your pot so you can keep track of it.
